rule: an evaluation item is HELD OUT for a checkpoint only if its patient key (a render inherits its source CT subject) is in neither the train nor the val/selection set of that checkpoint nor of any ancestor in its initialisation chain; public ImageNet / COCO weights are the only exempt ancestor, and only when declared

verdicts.NOT HELD OUT: an eval token is in a train or val/selection set on the chain
verdicts.MIXED: the row pools pairs with different verdicts
verdicts.N/A: no checkpoint (count, parameter, arithmetic, published number)

pose_donor_note: pose-donor overlap is reported, not scored: a styled/anchor render is a TotalSegmentator subject under the registered pose of a real frame. leak_check.py check (6) treats the donor as a dependency.
